entries.title: Dwarf Fortress
entries.definitive_edition: Dwarf Fortress Premium on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native Premium PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC Premium release is the best route for most players because it adds pixel graphics, music, sound, tutorialization, mouse/UI work, and Steam Workshop support while retaining the current Dwarf Fortress simulation. Classic remains a valid free route, but Premium is the highest-fidelity and most approachable complete version.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Dwarf Fortress Premium on Steam or itch.io for Windows PC and play the current build. Use the free Classic build from Bay 12 only if you specifically want the ASCII/freeware route.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Classic Windows release, later joined by the 2022 Premium Steam/itch.io release with graphics, music, UI, tutorials, Workshop support, and Adventure Mode support in the modern branch.
all_releases.reason: primary: Windows PC has both the historic Classic route and the best current Premium route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Linux Classic route, plus Premium availability through itch.io/Linux support.
all_releases.reason: skip: excellent native route, but Windows PC remains the most straightforward Premium/capture target.

all_releases.fidelity: Historic native Classic OS X/macOS route.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful historical/native route, but current Premium support is better documented for Windows/Linux.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Classic is free and important historically, but Premium carries the current approachable presentation and feature path. The same core simulation is the focus, so Windows PC Premium is both the fidelity and completeness recommendation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Premium is not a separate sequel; it is the commercial/polished branch with graphics, audio, UI, tutorials, and Workshop support. Classic remains free and receives gameplay updates, but it is not the preferred first-play route.
